summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories like Hugging Face that host and distribute weights, and developer-facing inference platforms like Together AI, Fireworks AI, Replicate, and SiliconFlow that serve those models via APIs. As of 2026, Hugging Face hosts over 3 million public models (crossing that milestone in August 2026), though downloads are highly concentrated — roughly half of all models have under 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for ~49.6% of all downloads. These hubs and inference APIs are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI).

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub for hosting, sharing, versioning, and discovering open AI models, datasets, and demo Spaces; also offers managed inference endpoints.
platforms.pricing: Free hosting for public repos; Pro plan ~$9/mo; Team/Enterprise tiers; Inference Endpoints and serverless Inference API billed per compute/usage; dedicated GPU hosting available
features: Largest open model and dataset repository
Git-based model versioning and model cards
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Download statistics and community collaboration tools
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and open source developers who need to publish, discover, or fine-tune models and datasets.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first tool for downloading and running open LLMs on personal machines with a simple CLI and local API server.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.), plus thousands importable via GGUF/Modelfiles
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees (runs on your own hardware); optional cloud offering for larger models
features: One-command local model download and run
Modelfile customization and quantized GGUF support
Runs offline with full data privacy
Growing integration with desktop and dev tools
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping and offline use.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and deploy open models (especially image, video, audio, and LLMs) via API without managing infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models; supports custom model deployment via Cog
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); some models priced per output/run; no subscription required
features: Run thousands of open models via a simple API
Cog packaging for deploying custom models
Strong support for image, video, and generative media models
Public model sharing and reproducible runs
platforms.best_for: App developers and startups wanting quick API access to generative models, especially multimodal, without infrastructure overhead.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open LLMs and multimodal models, offering fast serverless APIs and dedicated endpoints.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (per million input/output tokens, varies by model size); hourly GPU pricing for dedicated endpoints; fine-tuning billed per token/job
features: Optimized inference stack for low latency and high throughput
Dedicated GPU clusters and reserved capacity
Broad catalog of open chat, code, and image models
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies building production applications on open models who need scalable, cost-efficient inference and fine-tuning.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-focused inference platform for open and fine-tuned LLMs and multimodal models, optimized for low-latency production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom/fine-tuned model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing (per million tokens by model tier); on-demand GPU pricing for dedicated deployments; fine-tuning fees
features: Function calling and structured JSON outputs
platforms.best_for: Teams needing fast, reliable, production-grade inference and serving of fine-tuned open models at scale.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An inference cloud offering fast, affordable API access to a wide range of open LLMs, image, audio, and video models, popular in the Asia-Pacific market.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including Chinese and Western LLMs (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, FLUX, GLM)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token/usage with competitive low rates; free tier/credits for popular models; dedicated instance options
features: Strong catalog of leading Chinese open models
Text, image, audio, and video generation endpoints
Low-cost access to large open models
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking affordable inference across a broad set of open models, including top Chinese releases.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform running open LLMs on custom LPU hardware for extremely fast token generation.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek distillations)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with competitive rates; free developer tier with rate limits; enterprise/on-prem options
features: Custom LPU hardware for industry-leading speed
Curated selection of popular open models
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time or latency-sensitive applications (chat, agents, voice) on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated across dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing plus small routing fee; credits-based; no subscription
features: Single API for many providers and models
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open and frontier models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible access to many models and providers through one API with easy switching and cost optimization.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: A serverless cloud platform for deploying custom AI models, inference workloads, and batch jobs with code-first GPU scaling.
platforms.model_count: Not a fixed catalog — users deploy any open or custom model (unlimited)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second compute billing by GPU/CPU type; free monthly credits for new users
features: Run any open or custom model
platforms.best_for: Engineering teams that want to deploy custom open models and inference pipelines with code-level control and flexible scaling.
